events.strFilename: Boxing 2026-09-26 Zuffa Boxing 11 Fisher vs Pirotton
events.strDescriptionEN: Zuffa Boxing heads to London for its eleventh event, with popular British heavyweight Johnny Fisher making his promotional debut against Belgium’s Michael Pirotton at the Copper Box Arena. Fisher returns to a venue where he has already enjoyed notable success and will look to re-establish momentum in the heavyweight division, while Pirotton arrives with the opportunity to derail one of Zuffa Boxing’s most high-profile UK signings. The supporting card adds further intrigue through a light heavyweight clash between Craig Richards and Radivoje Kalajdzic, a domestic middleweight matchup between Louis Greene and Lee Cutler, and the professional debut of Kayla Allen, the first female boxer signed by Zuffa Boxing. With a strong British focus and several fighters seeking to position themselves for larger opportunities within the promotion, Zuffa Boxing 11 represents an important step in the company’s expansion into the UK market.

events.strFilename: Boxing 2026-09-26 Liam Davies vs Nathaniel Collins
events.strDescriptionEN: Liam Davies and Nathaniel Collins meet in Birmingham in a high-level all-British featherweight clash with major European and world-ranking implications. Davies enters as the reigning European champion and one of the division’s leading contenders, looking to strengthen his case for a world-title opportunity after establishing himself across multiple weight classes. Collins, a former British, Commonwealth and WBC Silver champion, arrives determined to rebound from his narrow defeat to Cristobal Lorente and reassert himself among the featherweight elite. The matchup brings together two experienced 30-year-old fighters with contrasting strengths, Davies’ precision and angle work against Collins’ pressure and southpaw aggression, in a contest that could significantly reshape the domestic and European picture at 126 pounds.

events.strFilename: Boxing 2026-09-26 Henry Cejudo vs Javon Walton
events.strDescriptionEN: Henry Cejudo makes his professional boxing debut in Miami against undefeated prospect Javon “Wanna” Walton in an unusual crossover main event under the Misfits Boxing banner. Cejudo brings one of the most distinguished combat-sports résumés of his generation, having won Olympic gold in freestyle wrestling before becoming a two-division UFC champion, but now faces the challenge of adapting his skill set to professional boxing. Walton enters with a 3-0-1 record and significantly more recent experience under boxing rules, giving the younger fighter an opportunity to score the most recognizable victory of his career. With Cejudo replacing his MMA gloves for boxing gloves and Walton stepping into a major-event spotlight, the matchup combines elite combat-sports pedigree with the unpredictability that defines crossover boxing.
